title: Crosshook Ops Quickledger — ad-hoc coverage & asks
body:
Purpose: quick, low-friction rollup of outstanding cross-team asks and who to ping for short-window coverage. Lightweight — meant for 1:1 syncs and a single handoff email. Not canonical project doc; copy action rows into tickets where ownership needs permanence.

Last quickscan: 2028-04-13 09:30 PT (Maya) — triage snapshot below.

Summary Metrics:
- total rows: 12
- open asks: 9
- high-priority (P0/P1): 4
- escalated to SRE/Infra: 2
- estimated total short-term effort: ~28-40 hrs (workable over 1 sprint)

Quick legend: Priority = P0/P1/P2/P3; Coverage Risk = numerical 1..5 (5 = no backup, immediate attention)

Table (row per ask):
ID | Owner | Stakeholder/Team | Primary contact (email/slack) | Region | Ask (1-2 lines) | Priority | Coverage Risk | Est. Effort (hrs) | Next touch | Notes / required artifact
1 | Maya C. | Growth — Experiments | priya@growth.redwood.com / @priya | NA | Need one-off 4h dedicated token sample run on dedicated cluster to validate infra billing delta for experiment (quant vs float). | P1 | 4 | 6 | 2028-04-14 | requires cluster slot request (infra ticket), sample dataset link: s3://growth/exp-2028-04-1
2 | Diego R. | Solutions Eng | solutions-leads@redwood.com / @diego | EMEA | Compile a short contact list of 3 partners that can take over a pilot region if Dedicated capacity oversubscribed. Need introductions. | P2 | 3 | 3 | 2028-04-18 | Intro templates in Confluence (see linked_artifacts)
3 | Asha K. | Security (GRC) | grc-ops@redwood.com / @asha | Global | Quick audit sample: 2 customer deployments that use private networking — need export of recent access logs (last 30d). | P0 | 5 | 8 | 2028-04-12 | Escalated to infra; ticket INF-911 created
4 | Jonas M. | Console — Rollouts | console@redwood.com / @jonas | NA | Short-run canary on new routing policy for low-latency tier; need 6h runway and fallback plan sign-off. | P1 | 4 | 4 | 2028-04-15 | Draft fallback emails and metrics to be watched: p50/p95 latency, error-rate
5 | Maya C. | Customer Success | cs@redwood.com / @sara | APAC | Compile list of 10 at-risk enterprise customers with dedicated capacity hitting quota limits this month. | P1 | 4 | 3 | 2028-04-14 | Pull from billing export, quick filter rules in sheet tab 'billing-filter'
6 | Diego R. | Platform Eng — Batching | platform-batching@redwood.com / @rahul | Global | Need quick micro-benchmark comparing 1 request batching vs continuous batching for embeddings workload sample. | P2 | 2 | 3 | 2028-04-20 | Use model: open-embed-v2, sample corpus link in row 1 notes
7 | Asha K. | Legal — Privacy | legal-privacy@redwood.com / @esme | NA | One-off doc: acceptable data flows for customer-managed KMS for private deployments. Short summary for sales (1 pager). | P3 | 2 | 2 | 2028-04-25 | Draft in /templates/priv-kms-1pager.md
8 | Jonas M. | Observability | obs@redwood.com / @mira | NA | Quick check: add one extra tracing hook for model-fallback branch to reduce blindspots for rollouts. | P2 | 3 | 2 | 2028-04-16 | Low-risk; ask DevX to add trace tag 'fallback.variant'
9 | Maya C. | Solutions Eng — Pilot | se-pilots@redwood.com / @lia | NA | Need list of SEs to be on-call during pilot week (May 2-8) and backup rotation. | P1 | 5 | 3 | 2028-04-18 | Hotlist required; coordinate with SE manager
10 | Diego R. | Release Eng | releng@redwood.com / @carl | Global | Small cleanup request: one-off toggle to disable nonblocking debug logs for a release window. | P3 | 1 | 1 | 2028-04-14 | Can be done by releng; low impact
11 | Asha K. | Compliance — Audit Prep | compliance@redwood.com / @tom | NA | Collect retention config snapshots for 6 tenants for Q2 readiness. | P1 | 3 | 4 | 2028-04-20 | Data in config-service, need export access
12 | Maya C. | Product Ops | ops@redwood.com / @matt | NA | Quick count: how many routes are on fallback-heavy policy this week (>=3 fallbacks triggered). Need one-line summary for Monday standup. | P2 | 2 | 1 | 2028-04-16 | Query: analytics.fallbacks.weekly

Auto-triage notes (manual heuristics used during scan):
- Anything with Coverage Risk >=4 flagged for immediate ping (DM + email).
- Anything P0/P1 with est hrs >6 considered candidate for ticketing into sprint (owner to convert).
- Items with 'Escalated to infra' have been posted to INF Slack channel and INF ticket referenced.

Short analysis / prioritization rationale:
- Immediate blockers: rows 3 (security logs) and 9 (pilot SE coverage) — both have high business or compliance risk. Escalated and owner-assigned.
- Campaign experiments (row 1) can be batched with row 6 benchmarking to save infra churn if owners coordinate (Maya & Diego). Recommend sync 30m.
- Low-effort cleanups (rows 10, 12) assigned to releng/ops; quick wins to reduce noise.

Next steps (owner-level):
- Maya: confirm SE on-call list and open CS ticket for billing data pull (by 2028-04-14).
- Diego: run embedding micro-benchmark and share raw numbers in this sheet (by 2028-04-20).
- Asha: follow up on INF-911 and share exported 30d logs (by 2028-04-13) — if not available escalate to SRE lead.
- Jonas: prepare rollout fallback email templates and short metric dashboard (by 2028-04-15).

Sticky notes / unresolved questions:
- Who owns the canonical list of pilot SEs? (SE manager not responding to Slack thread — @matt to escalate)
- If infra cannot provide cluster slot for row 1 this week, is it acceptable to run the sample on a smaller GPU with proportionate scaling? (Maya to confirm)

Use guidance: copy rows into Jira/Linear when converting to tracked work. For flash coverage or handoff, use the subject line: "Crosshook Quickledger handoff — <ID> — <owner>" and paste the row.

Changelog (mini):
- 2028-04-11: initial scan (Maya)
- 2028-04-12: added row 3 after security ping (Asha)
- 2028-04-13: adjusted priorities after infra sync; estimated effort updated

If you are reading this and need to claim an item, add your name in the Owner column and ping the collaborators list above.

End of quickledger.
